_readme: How the commoners' map moves between DJ's keyframes, and how the app works out its starter keyframes (scripts/build_years_commoners.py). DJ, 15 Oct 2026: keyframes only; between two, "new rulers + shift time"; before his earliest, "earlier rulers, else lost"; shift time "mostly 300 years ... vary it". DJ, 19 Oct 2026: raised to 400 (±50%), near Earth's 250-650 years after a conquest.
